qualitative_lessons_only: one or more visible overhead discontinuity layers
price later approaches or re-enters the old zone
the concept may be layered rather than one single gap
same-day gap bounce may not represent the intended persistent discontinuity

semantic_preflight.economic_sequence: prior strong-stock or leader phase -> major run-up -> peak -> collapse or liquidation -> one or more true downward price discontinuities during collapse -> unresolved overhead gap primitives or stack -> time below -> later approach from below -> candidate first upward re-entry for human semantic review
semantic_preflight.causal_background: prior speculative or leadership demand followed by liquidation and collapse
semantic_preflight.event_formation_time: the collapse phase in which one or more adjacent-session strict downward gap primitives are created
semantic_preflight.confirmation_trigger: NOT_FROZEN; lower touch, lower close, 10 percent penetration, 50 percent penetration, full fill, nearest-layer entry, and next-layer entry are retained for blind semantic adjudication
possible_semantic_ambiguities: single strict gap versus multi-gap collapse zone
whether adjacent gap primitives should be merged
how much traded-price overlap is allowed inside a broader collapse zone
the minimum persistence implied by 留下
whether one completed session below the zone is enough
whether multiple sessions completely below the zone are required
whether the relevant trigger is the lower boundary of the nearest unresolved layer
whether layered zones are independent or hierarchical
whether board-relative return ranking adequately represents a former leader
whether the main rise must be fast or impulsive rather than merely large
whether a bottom or base phase is required
whether declining turnover is essential or secondary

chosen_time_anchors.strict_gap_formation: current session raw open versus immediately previous comparable session raw low
chosen_time_anchors.primitive_interval: [Open_t, Low_t_minus_1] in a corporate-action-safe comparable coordinate
chosen_time_anchors.reentry_clock_start: after price first moves strictly below the primitive lower boundary; the formation opening print itself is not a re-entry
chosen_time_anchors.blind_chart_review_marker: first upward lower-boundary touch of the lowest unresolved primitive, used only as a high-recall display anchor
chosen_time_anchors.blind_chart_end: exact completed one-minute re-entry bar; no later minute or session is shown
chosen_time_anchors.daily_context_end: the chosen review-marker session, with its last candle rebuilt only from minutes available through the marker

scientific_distinctions.collapse_region: broader decline containing traded and possibly untraded prices
scientific_distinctions.zone_stack: multiple retained strict-gap primitives provisionally grouped within one collapse
scientific_distinctions.visual_discontinuity_zone: unfrozen human concept to be learned from blind labels

retrieval_contract.strict_gap: Open_t < Low_t_minus_1 on adjacent comparable sessions; no Open times 1.01 condition
retrieval_contract.threshold_interpretation: high-recall audit retrieval only; not economic or strategy thresholds

sample.selection: deterministic outcome-blind round-robin over board, ST, single/multilayer, persistence, and provisional leadership strata
